owner_scope: Resolve only native cloud video playback/access; no computer; one stage and source at a time.
selection_basis: Official documentation explicitly supports YouTube URL ingest, HLS playback, timestamp-based stream generation, API and hosted MCP.

public_console_observation.free_offer_displayed: $20 free credits, no credit card needed

first_playback_window.selection: Reuse already registered source and opening window; no new market discovery.

execution_order: User completes secure existing-account sign-in or manual signup if needed; no passwords or API keys in chat.
Read account usage and billing; confirm usable free allowance and no paid billing or automatic overage.
Inspect collection for existing exact source mapping; never repeat an already completed ingestion.
Upload exactly one existing source URL only after free cost/limits are verified. Persist source URL/provider video ID and request result before next action.
Generate only the existing [0,40] playback window; do not index, transcribe or invoke a video AI model.
Open the returned actual player URL and verify moving source time, nonzero native decoded dimensions, delivered audio stream and source-window provenance.
Stop and record failure if unavailable. No proxy, cookie export, site-control bypass, repeated ingest, duplicate playback request or paid fallback.
